data_description.read_only: On by default. While on, every setting change and clock sync is refused with an error and the entity keeps the inverter's value.
data_description.connection_mode: Standard reconnects every poll and leaves the logger's radio free for Deye Cloud. Live holds one link and polls fast: 'with Deye Cloud' releases it for a quiet window so the cloud upload keeps working; 'local only' never does, and Deye Cloud stops updating. A held link also occupies an ESP proxy slot and blocks the phone app.
